source.authors: Stanley SK, Ghanayem AJ, Voronov LI, Havey RM, Paxinos O, Carandang G, Zindrick MR, Patwardhan AG
source.sample: 7 fresh human cadaveric T2-sacrum thoracolumbar spines (ligamentous; no rib cage visible in Fig. 1B, not stated in text); no metastatic disease or bridging osteophytes

protocol.summary: T2 and sacrum potted in cups (cement, pins); mounted in neutral posture with L1 over the sacrum. FE moments by water flowing into bags on loading arms on the T2 cup; continuous cycling between 8 Nm flexion and 6 Nm extension until 2 reproducible loops. Follower preload via bilateral cables from the T2 cup through adjustable guides on each body T4-sacrum to a hanger; path optimised in neutral posture (800 N changed T2-L1 kyphosis by 2.3 +/- 1.6 deg and L1-S lordosis by 1.8 +/- 1.3 deg). Order: 0 N baseline, then 800, 600, 400, 200 N (descending), >= 5 min between. Optotrak markers on T2, T4, T6, T9, L3 relative to the sacrum; biaxial angle sensors on T2, T5, T8, T10, T11, L1, L2, L4, L5; 6-axis load cell under the specimen.
how_to_simulate: Model the ligamentous T2-sacrum spine without rib cage; fix the sacrum, load at the T2 cup
Apply a follower preload of 0, 200, 400, 600 or 800 N along a path tangent to the kypholordotic curve (optimised to minimise posture change in neutral)
Apply 8 Nm flexion and 6 Nm extension to T2
Report sagittal rotation range (flexion+extension) of the region: T2-sacrum, T2-T11, T11-L1 or L1-sacrum
protocol.notes: Table 1, mean (SD), n = 7. Regional ROM probably from the T11/L1 angle sensors (Optotrak markers were on T2, T4, T6, T9, L3; not stated). Preload order not randomised (descending). Same lab as Patwardhan 2003 / Renner 2007 (L1-S1 specimens) but different, longer specimens; no overlap stated.

extraction.check_notes: Read from the PDF text layer. T2-sacrum 73.0 -> 56.6 deg at 800 N (-22 %) and T2-T11 / L1-S -23 % / -30 % match the abstract. T2-T11 at 200 N printed '24' (taken as 24.0). pct_of_0N and pct_of_T2S1 as printed (rounded integers).

loading.device: water-bag moment apparatus, Optotrak 3020, biaxial angle sensors, AMTI 6-axis load cell

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD; ROM of T2-S1, T2-T11 and L1-S1 decreases with preload >= 400 N, T11-L1 unchanged
